title: Protocol for enhanced proliferation of human pluripotent stem cells in tryptophan-fortified media
protocol: Place mTeSR1 solution in a 50 mL conical tube covered by a shading sheet at room temperature for 30-60 minutes to warm.
Thaw an aliquot of 10 mM Y-27632 diluted with DMSO.
Add 10 mM Y-27632 to the mTeSR1 solution (1:1,000 dilution) to prepare an mTeSR1 solution containing 10 μM Y-27632.
Thaw hPSCs in a 37°C water bath from cryotubes stored at -150°C.
Transfer the thawed cell solution into a conical tube containing 10 mL of normal mTeSR1 with Y-27632 using a sterile 1,000 μL tip attached to a P1000 pipette.
Centrifuge the tube for 3 minutes at 300 x g.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully without disturbing the cell pellet.
Add 10 mL of normal mTeSR1 containing 10 μM Y-27632.
Gently stir the cells by suction and discharge using an electronic pipette controller with a sterile serological pipette, repeating no more than ten times.
Transfer an aliquot of the solution to dishes or plates at a density of approximately 3.4 × 10^3 cells per cm².
Add 500 μL of medium per well in 6-well plates before dispensing the diluted cell suspension with 1.5 mL of medium containing the designated number of cells per well.
Place dishes or plates in an incubator at 37°C.
Gently move the dishes side-to-side to evenly spread the cells without causing contamination.
Seed hPSCs in a conventional setting without TRP initially.
Change the medium to TRP-fortified mTeSR1 on the next medium change day if cells were cultured on a dish or plate containing mTeSR1.
Switch cells to mTeSR1 medium on the day after medium change if they were grown in different media, followed by TRP-fortified mTeSR1.
Do not passage confluent cells cultured in non-fortified mTeSR1 into TRP-fortified mTeSR1 with Y-27632.
Passage cells using conventional mTeSR1 with Y-27632 initially, then change the medium to TRP-fortified mTeSR1 after at least 12 hours of culture in conventional TRP-concentration medium.
Change hPSC culture medium to Y-27632 depleted TRP-fortified medium.
Place the required amount of TRP-fortified mTeSR1 solution in a conical tube covered by a shading sheet at room temperature for approximately 30–60 min.
Observe cells in the dish or plate microscopically under an inverted microscope.
Clean the microscope thoroughly using 70% ethanol prior to and after use.
Tilt the dish or plate, aspirate the culture medium, and change medium to TRP-fortified mTeSR1 solution (without Y-27632).
Change the medium every other day with TRP-fortified mTeSR1 solution.
Passage hPSCs when cells are 60%–80% confluent.
Prepare TRP-fortified mTeSR1 with 10 μM Y-27632 in a conical tube and warm at room temperature (approximately 21°C).
Coat dishes or plates with Matrigel as previously described.
Replace the coating with TRP-fortified mTeSR1 containing 10 μM Y-27632.
Observe cells microscopically before passaging.
Aspirate medium from the dish or plate.
Wash the dish or plate gently with PBS and aspirate the supernatant.
Add TrypLE Select to dissociate the cells, depending on the surface area of the dish or plate.
Incubate the dish or plate in an incubator at 37°C for approximately 3 minutes.
Observe the dish or plate to ensure that the cells are well-dissociated prior to the next step.
Incubate for longer periods if the cells do not dissociate.
Add 10 mL of TRP-fortified mTeSR1 with Y-27632 to a 10-cm dish.
Gently detach the cells and transfer all cell suspensions to a conical tube using an electronic pipette controller.
Alternatives: Cells can be collected directly using a 1,000 μL pipette tip after gentle pipetting.
Transfer collected cells promptly to a tube containing 10 mL TRP-fortified StemFit AK02N with Y-27632.
Centrifuge the tube for 3 min at 300 × g.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully without suctioning the cell pellet.
Mix 10 mL of normal mTeSR1 with 10 μM Y-27632 and gently stir cells using multiple bouts of suction.
Discharge contents using an electronic pipette controller with a sterile serological pipette.
Perform a cell count using Vi-CELL XR or equivalent.
Assess cell density within the sampled solution and viability.
Seed cells onto prepared dishes or plates based on planned cell density or split-cell ratio.
Seed cells at a density of 1.7 × 10^3 cells per cm² in dishes or plates.
Place the seeded dishes or plates in an incubator at 37°C.
Gently move dishes side-to-side to evenly spread the cells without contamination.
Culture hPSCs using TRP-fortified mTeSR1 for at least two weeks.
Prepare 10 mL of TRP-fortified mTeSR1 with 10 μM Y-27632 in a conical tube.
Keep the prepared medium in the dark.
Prepare cryotubes and record data such as date, cell line, passage number, TRP-fortification status, cell count, and medium used before freezing.
Centrifuge the tube for 3 min at 300 × g.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Add 500 μL of STEM-CELLBANKER per 1–5 × 10^6 cells.
Gently disperse the cells by pipetting with a sterile 1,000 μL tip attached to a P1000 pipette.
Immediately after pipetting, transfer 500 μL of cryopreservation solution to each prepared cryotube.
Place the cryotubes in BICELL freezing vessels.
Store the vessels in a −80°C freezer.
Remove cryotubes from the vessels overnight (8–24 h) and store in a freezer at −150°C for long-term preservation.
Turn on IncuCyte ZOOM.
Establish a protocol for imaging including plates and cells, scan mode, imaging intervals, and parameters for image processing.
Seed cells onto plates compatible with the imaging system.
Gently move seeded plates side-to-side to evenly spread the cells without contamination.
Place plates firmly in the instrument tray specific to the culture vessel.
Start imaging.
Change medium as required.
Analyze data using MS-Excel.
Prepare hPSCs that are approximately 40%–60% confluent grown on 10-cm dishes or 6-well plates.
Transfer the medium containing 3 × 10^6–6 × 10^6 cells per cell line to another conical tube.
Centrifuge the tube for 3 min at 300 × g.
Aspirate the supernatant and add 300 μl of a solution containing 2% FBS in PBS.
Divide the solution into three aliquots of 100 μl each in a 1.5 ml microtube.
Add 10 μl of each antibody to a separate microtube.
Place the microtubes in the dark on ice for 30 min.
Add 1 ml of 2% FBS to each microtube and centrifuge for 3 min at 1,250 × g or 5 min at 300 × g.
Using a pipette tip, aspirate supernatant.
Add 500 μl of 2% FBS in PBS to each of the microtubes.
Dispense solutions through a cell strainer cap into separate test tubes.
Run the flow cytometer.
Prepare hPSCs at 40%-60% confluency on 6-well plates for immunocytochemistry.
Aspirate medium from hPSCs.
Wash hPSCs with 2 mL of PBS per well and aspirate.
Fix cells by adding 1-1.5 mL of 4% paraformaldehyde per well, then refrigerate at 4°C.
Incubate plates in refrigerator at 4°C for 30-60 min.
Aspirate 4% paraformaldehyde.
Wash hPSCs with 2 mL of PBS per well and aspirate (twice).
Add 1 mL of 0.1% Triton X-100 per well to permeabilize cells, then leave at room temperature for 1-15 min.
Aspirate 0.1% Triton X-100.
Wash each well with 2 mL of PBS and aspirate.
Add approximately 1.5–2 mL of ImmunoBlock per well.
Dilute primary antibodies with ImmunoBlock in separate conical tubes (1 mL per well).
Aspirate ImmunoBlock from the plates and add diluted primary antibodies.
Wash each well with 5 mL of PBS and aspirate twice.
Prepare secondary antibodies diluted with ImmunoBlock in separate conical tubes (1 mL per well required).
Add diluted secondary antibodies to the plates.
Wash each well with 5 mL of PBS and aspirate twice.
Prepare 2 mL of 0.02 mg/mL Hoechst 33342 by mixing 1.998 mL of PBS and 0.001 mL of 10 mg/mL Hoechst 33342.
Add 1 mL of 0.02 mg/mL Hoechst 33342 per well and leave in the dark at 20°C for 30 min.
Wash each well with 5 mL of PBS and aspirate twice.
Add 1.5–2 mL of ImmunoBlock per well.
Image cells using a fluorescence inverted microscope suitable for immunohistochemistry.
If imaging is to be performed later, store the plates in the dark place at 4°C for up to one week.
